extension.summary: Automated library maintenance: scraping, refresh, cleaning, texture cache, backup, and network sync.
extension.description:
PowerToys automates Kodi library maintenance.
Scraping: scheduled scans of configured TV/movie source folders for new content. Refresh: periodic metadata refresh; can target only items missing artwork or with blank plot/MPAA. Cleaning: removes missing files and duplicate entries (quality-weighted, IMDb-aware); runs after scans or on schedule; exclude list protects chosen titles. Texture cache: prunes orphaned artwork and re-caches missing thumbnails via the Textures JSON-RPC API; optional disk file deletion. Backup: scheduled library export to a chosen folder. Sync: broadcasts library refresh to network peers (zeroconf discovery) with confirmations and retry. Maintenance: scan-error retry, offline-share alerts, context menu actions (clean show/movie, scan folder, health report). All destructive operations honor Dry Run, and file deletion is a separate opt-in.
extension.news: v1.3.0 (2026-10-26) - Add: peer scan push - scan commands received by any instance are queued and retried until every networked PowerToys instance confirms (paths propagate; offline peers picked up on wake) - Add: watched/resume state sync across peers - playback progress and manual mark-watched propagate automatically (newest lastplayed wins) - Add: season cleanup - context menu deletes a season's files and library entries behind an always-on confirmation, gated by Dry Run - Add: batch mark watched/unwatched for a show or season from the context menu - Add: music library scan/clean scheduling with its own interval - Add: network share recovery watcher (auto-rescan when a share comes back online) - Add: Wake-on-LAN - auto-fire on failed peer pushes, web endpoint, and QR command (comma-separated MAC list) - Add: backup rotation - timestamped exports with keep-N pruning (gated by Dry Run) - Add: system cache cleanup with confirmation (temp, packages, old logs) - gated by Dry Run - Add: Free RAM tool - Python garbage collection plus platform memory trim (glibc malloc_trim / Android mallopt / Windows working set), manual and scheduled - Add: web log viewer (/log) and HTML health report (/report) - Add: QR presets for play media, screenshot, and wake - Fix: strings.po #32055 typo
